Courses
Home
Academics
Courses
UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMMES
ASBC College, Udali Bazar, Hojai, Assam
offers both Honours Course (Major) and Minor or Regular Course (RC) at the undergraduate level. The courses are designed in accordance with the guidelines of Rabindranath Thakur Vishwavidyalaya (RTV) under the Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) based on NEP-2020.
COURSE REQUIREMENTS FOR COMPLETION
Undergraduate Degree with Honours
(ASBC College under Rabindranath Thakur Vishwavidyalaya)
To obtain an Honours Degree, a student must successfully complete the following course :
Core Courses (CC)
Ability Enhancement Compulsory Courses (AECC)
Skill Enhancement Courses (SEC)
Discipline Specific Electives (DSE)
Generic Electives (GE)/Multidisciplinary Courses (MDC)
Open Elective Courses (OEC)
SUBJECTS OFFERED
Honours Course (HC)
1. Assamese
2. Political Science
3. Philosophy
4. Education
5. Economics
6. English
7. History
Regular Course (RC) / Minor Course
1. Assamese / Advance Assamese
2. Education
3. History
4. Philosophy
5. Economics
6. Political Science
7. English
8. Hindi
9. Geography
Core Course (CC)
Core Courses are compulsory components of the programme
Honours students:
14 Core Courses
Regular students:
12 Core Courses
Each Core Course carries
6 credits
Elective Courses
Students can choose from the following electives offered by the college
Discipline Specific Elective (DSE)
Generic Elective (GE)/Multidisciplinary Courses (MDC)
Ability Enhancement Courses (AEC)
These Courses are designed to improve skills and competencies:
Ability Enhancement Compulsory Course (AECC) — 4 Credits
Skill Enhancement Course (SEC) — 4 Credits
Open Elective Course (OEC) — 4 Credits
These Courses are skill-based and designed as per the guidelines of Rabindranath Thakur Vishwavidyalaya (RTV)
SCHOLARSHIP
Scholarships are available for students belonging to:
SC/ST/OBC/MOBC
Minority Communities.
Meritorious students
These are provided as per Government rules.
LIBRARY
The College has a well-equipped Central Library that supports :
Academic Learning
Research activities
Overall intellectual development

The College has a dedicated team of:
Teaching Staff.
Non-Teaching Staff
Who contribute to the smooth functioning and academic excellence of the institution.
Committed to excellence in education, research, and innovation since 1997. We empower students to become leaders who make a difference in the world.
